Archive ABI · Collection and marketplace ABI

What can change?

The archive rejects contract replacement and has no edit or delete path for finalized image bytes and metadata. Sealing it ends all uploads.

The collection contract remains upgradeable by its contract account. Its administrator can pause purchases. Pausing does not block owner transfers or listing cancellations. An upgrade can change ownership and trading rules; the archive remains independent.
